So, Felipe. If you could change one thing in the company, what would it be?
The approvals for small repairs. Today every repair needs three.
Even a broken door?
Even a broken door. The store manager waits nine days, and fills in the same paperwork three times.
And what would you do instead?
I would empower the store managers. If they approved repairs below two thousand reais, they would solve most problems in a day.
Would it cost anything?
Nothing. It would actually save money, and a lot of time.
What would finance say?
They would worry about control. That is the main drawback, and I understand it.
So how would you get their buy-in?
With a pilot. If we started in twenty stores, we would have real numbers in three months.
If I could change one thing, it would be this.
If we had fewer approvals, the stores would be faster.
The main drawback would be less control.
We could start with a pilot in twenty stores.

Felipe, hi, it's Karen from the CEO's office. A quick message about the directors' offsite next Thursday. This year the format is different. Every director gets five minutes and one question: if you could change one thing in the company, what would it be? Not a plan for the whole year, just one change. Please say what you would change, what would happen if we did it, and what the main drawback would be. If the idea needs money, bring a number. And if I were you, I wouldn't use slides. The CEO prefers people who talk to the room.

Hi Felipe, it's Ingrid. I just wanted to say your talk at the offsite was one of the best. The CEO liked the idea of the store managers approving small repairs, and he wants a pilot. If you started in twenty stores, he would like to see the first results in ninety days. Finance has one condition: a limit for each store, every month. Oh, and one small thing about your English. You said, if I would have the budget. In English, it's if I had the budget. The would only goes in the other half of the sentence. Congratulations again.

First, Ingrid asks Felipe what he would change if he could change one thing. Then Felipe says he would cut the three approvals for small repairs. After that, he explains that store managers would solve problems in a day. Next, Ingrid asks about the main drawback. Finally, Felipe says they could start with a pilot in twenty stores.
